task2.q: Some people think that schools should teach practical life skills, such as cooking, managing money and basic first aid, rather than focusing mainly on academic subjects. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: Время в школе ограничено: что убрать?

ideas: Офис: командная работа, границы работы и дома

task2.q: Many people now use artificial intelligence tools to help with writing, research and decision making. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?
Plastic waste is damaging oceans and wildlife in many parts of the world. What are the causes of this problem and what measures could be taken to solve it?
In many countries, people are living longer than ever before. What problems might this cause for society? What can governments do to prepare for these problems?
Governments should spend more money on public transport rather than on building new roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
ideas: Дороги нужны для грузов и сельских районов

task2.q: Some people think that children should start learning a foreign language at primary school, while others believe it is better to wait until secondary school. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
More and more people get their news from social media instead of newspapers and television. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?
Some people believe that the best way to reduce crime is to give longer prison sentences. Others believe there are better alternatives. To what extent do you agree?
Many cities are becoming more crowded and expensive to live in. What problems does this cause and what can be done about it?
Some people say that children spend too much time using screens. Why is this happening? What can parents and schools do to encourage other activities?
As cultures become more similar because of global trade and media, local traditions are disappearing. Is this a positive or negative development?
Some people say that a high salary is the most important factor when choosing a job. Others believe that job satisfaction matters more. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
Many universities now offer degrees entirely online. What are the advantages and disadvantages of studying in this way?
Fewer people are taking regular exercise than in the past. What are the reasons for this, and how can people be encouraged to be more active?
Individuals can do very little to protect the environment, and only governments and large companies can make a real difference. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
In some countries, young people are leaving rural areas to live and work in cities. What are the reasons for this? Is it a positive or negative development?
Some people believe that museums and historical sites should be free for everyone. Others think visitors should pay. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
In many countries, people are working fewer hours per week or four days instead of five. What are the advantages and disadvantages of a shorter working week?
Governments should invest more in scientific research even if it does not lead to immediate benefits. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

gt.q: You recently stayed at a hotel. The heating did not work properly during your stay. Write a letter to the hotel manager. In your letter: describe what went wrong; explain how it affected your stay; say what you would like the hotel to do.

A friend is visiting your town next month. Write a letter to your friend. In your letter: tell him or her what the weather is usually like; suggest things to do; offer to meet him or her at the station.

You would like to join an evening course at a local college. Write a letter to the college secretary. In your letter: say which course interests you; explain why you want to take it; ask about dates, price and registration.
Your neighbour plays loud music late at night. Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter: describe the problem; explain how it affects you; suggest a solution.
You have just started a new job. Write a letter to a friend. In your letter: describe the job; say what you like and dislike about it; invite your friend to visit you.
You borrowed a book from the town library and lost it. Write a letter to the librarian. In your letter: explain what happened; say when you borrowed the book; offer to solve the problem.
